get.description:
Search open, de-duplicated, listed jobs by keywords and by meaning. Results carry no fit claims.

meta.mode says what ran: hybrid falls back to keyword when no job has a vector yet or the model is unavailable.
With apply_constraints the caller's own hard constraints are applied (CHT-02) and meta.constraints_applied is true;
it needs a session (401 otherwise) and the person is always the session's, never a parameter.

parameters.name: apply_constraints

schema.description: Signed in only: leave out jobs that break your hard constraints.
schema.title: Apply Constraints

parameters.description: Signed in only: leave out jobs that break your hard constraints.

get.description: One listed job, open or closed, with its plain-text description and its requirements with character spans.

post.description: Local mode only (API.md 2.2): open a session for the owner with no code. Same cookie as create_session.

patch.description:
Grant or withdraw consents and change the time zone and the brief schedule. The person is the session's, never
anything in the body (T-3-01).

put.description:
Save the provider and key, sealed. The environment wins: if it already names the provider or holds a key for it,
nothing saved here would be used, so that is a 409 instead of a silent no-op.

get.description: current_user answers 401 with the usual envelope before any stream byte. It runs in the threadpool itself.

post.description: Ask for an archive of everything held about the caller. Asking again while one is being made returns that one.

get.description: The archive, opened from its seal for this one response. 409 while it is not ready, 410 once it has expired.

post.description:
Close the caller's account at once and queue the erasure of everything about them. Needs a fresh emailed code.

The Idempotency-Key is required (API.md 1.6) but not used to replay: the single-use code plays that part, and once
this has worked the session is gone, so a retry cannot get here. Nothing runs inside write.run for the same reason:
a wrong code must be counted, and an error raised inside the transaction would roll the count back.

get.description:
Every automated decision and every agent action about the caller, newest first, from the sources each module
registered. Everything runs on the caller's own API connection: another person's entries are not visible to it.

post.description:
Keep a resume and queue its parse: 202 with the document's id, and a Location to poll. The same key with the
same file answers with the first answer and stores nothing more. The parameters are checked in the order written.

file.description: A PDF or DOCX, at most 10 MB.

get.description:
How a parse is going and what it made. Poll this until status is succeeded or failed (Retry-After says how long
to wait). ?include=text adds the cleaned text the facts' spans point into, and its lines. Another person's document
is a 404, like one that does not exist.

post.description: Confirm, correct or reject one or many facts in one write: all of them happen, or none does.

Make this the person's hard constraint of its kind. There is one active constraint per kind, so this replaces
the one there is (the change log keeps it): to keep part of it, PATCH it.

A soft preference. A dealbreaker is stored as untyped_dealbreaker with notice not_guaranteed; when it fits a hard
constraint kind the answer also carries suggested_constraint, which the candidate may post to /constraints.

get.description: The change log, newest first: applied, declined and expired. ?status=proposed lists proposals still waiting.

The matches shown on a date, ranked, each with the requirement evidence table. Zero is a valid day. A job the
caller's hard constraints exclude now, whatever they said when the run made the match, is not listed.

One shown match with the posting's text (for the highlights) and a check of each hard constraint. 404 when the
job is one the caller's hard constraints now exclude: GET /v1/decisions/{id} reads it as filtered.

post.description:
Save, unsave or dismiss a match. A dismissal reason may propose a record change; it changes nothing until the
person confirms it through /v1/me/events.

get.description:
The decision ledger, newest first. ?job_id= returns the stored decision for one job, or checks that job against
the caller's hard constraints on the spot (no model call, nothing stored) and returns filtered or not_evaluated. A
shown match whose job the caller's hard constraints now exclude is reported as filtered, by the filters too.

One decision of any outcome, with its evidence, the constraint that filtered it or the gaps that withheld it. A
shown match whose job the caller's hard constraints now exclude reads as filtered.
Past briefs, newest first: the in-app inbox. A day with nothing to say is listed as suppressed.

post.description:
RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe: withdraws the brief_email consent of the person the signed token names. No
session, no cookie, no redirect; asking again changes nothing. A GET to this path does nothing at all.
Ask for a tailored resume. It is built in the background: poll the read until its status is ready or failed.

Approve or reject passed edits. An edit already decided is 409 `already_decided`; an id that is not a passed edit
of this tailored resume is 404.

get.description: The resume with approved edits only. Rendered on every request and stored nowhere.
The tracker: every application with its whole status history, the most recently changed first.

post.description: Record that the person applied. One application per job: a second is 409 with state `application_exists`.

Record a new status (interview, offer, rejected, no response, or applied again) and when it happened. The same
status as the current one is 409 `same_status`; a time before the current status or in the future is 422.

Prepare the packet for a job. It is drafted in the background: poll the read until its status is ready or failed.
A second request for the job supersedes the first.

get.description: The person's current packets, newest first; `job_id` limits them to one job.
The packet as a PDF (the only format). Rendered on every request and stored nowhere.

post.description: Open a session. `onboarding` is accepted and stored and runs the same agent (decision 22).

get.description:
The person's messages in order: their own, the agent's tool rows and its replies, each reply with the ledger rows
it cites and the record changes it proposed. `finish_reason` is null while a reply is still being written.

post.description:
Send a message. 202 with the reply's id and where to stream it; the reply is written whether or not anyone
listens. 403 without the ai_processing consent, 503 with no model, 429 past 30 messages an hour, 409 while a
reply of theirs is still being written.

get.description:
The reply's events. A plain `def`: the ownership check and the database read run in the thread pool, then a
response whose body is an async generator takes over, so waiting for the next event holds no thread. 404 before the
first byte for a reply that is not the caller's.

204.description: The reply is finished and the client has its end: stop reconnecting

post.description: Stop a reply: it ends as `stopped` at the next model turn or tool call. A reply that has ended stays as it is.

Approve a match: start a campaign at `researching`. A second start for the job is 409 with the open campaign's
id, a closed job 410, a job that breaks a hard constraint 422, no AI-processing consent 403.

get.description: One column per stage (the closed one only when asked); each card has its pause, next step and approvals.

patch.description: Change the budget, `follow_up_after_days` or `follow_up_email`. A closed campaign is 409.

post.description: Resume. A campaign paused at its budget is 409 `budget_exhausted` until `PATCH` raises the budget.
Cancel. `reason` offer_accepted or offer_declined only at the offer stage.

get.description: The person's approvals of one status, the soonest to expire first (pending) or the newest decided.

schema.title: Response Read Approval V1 Approvals  Approval Id  Get

post.description:
Say yes to exactly the payload the person saw. The answer is recorded now and `release` is `pending`: the worker
runs both keys again and schedules or blocks the action, and the page polls until it is `scheduled` or `blocked`.
With `edits` this approval is `rejected` (note `edited`) and the replacement action follows the same way.
Say no, with an optional note. Nothing leaves.

put.description:
Replace the given levels and the undo window. A level the type does not allow refuses the whole body (422
`autonomy_not_allowed`) and saves nothing; a stale `If-Match` is 412 `version_conflict`.

get.description:
Every entry of a campaign or a run in order (exactly one of the two ids). Each entry is one recorded step; the
Guardian's checks, the approval and the outcome belong to its row.

schema.title: Response Recorder V1 Control Recorder Get

get.description:
One entry in full: inputs, evidence, model calls, the policy decision, every check with its reason and the
payload. Reading it calls no model.

schema.title: Response Recorder Entry V1 Control Recorder  Entry Id  Get

post.description:
Take back a follow-up still waiting in its undo window. After the relay claimed the message it is `409 conflict`
with the state (`sending`, `sent`, `executed`).

Invite an address. One email is queued with the invitation. 403 for a plain member; 409 conflict, state invited
(already pending) or member (already belongs).
Accept the invitation sent to the caller's own address; any other caller gets 404.

patch.description: Change a role. 403 for a plain member, or for an admin who touches an owner; 409 conflict, state last_owner.

delete.description: Remove a member or revoke an invitation. 409 conflict, state last_owner, for the last owner.

post.description: An active admin becomes owner of an organization with no active owner; else 409 conflict, state has_owner.

Describe a role. The requirements are read from the description (synchronously); with no model the role is
stored with none and extraction.state says ai_disabled, so the employer types them.

patch.description: Change a draft. An open or closed role is 409 conflict (state open or closed).

put.description: Replace the draft's requirement list. It counts as confirmed when it is not empty and every item is.

post.description:
Open the role as an unlisted job and queue the ask. 422 pay_range_required or requirements_unconfirmed (every
blocker in details.blockers); 409 conflict while answers are overdue or when the role is not a draft.
Close an open role: asks still waiting are withdrawn; accepted introductions keep their answer obligation.

get.description: The anonymous preview. role_preview() answers only for a member of the role's organization (NULL otherwise).
Candidate: their own introductions. Employer (`role_id` or `org_id`): the accepted ones of that organization.

The signals the caller sent and received and the weekly quota: a candidate's own, or with `org_id` a member's
organization (candidate signals appear only after the candidate accepted).

ApplicationView.title: ApplicationView
ApplicationView.description: One application as the tracker shows it, and as the chat tool reads it.

AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry
AuditLogEntry.description: One automated decision or event about the caller. `summary` is built by code from codes and counts.

BriefAction.title: BriefAction
BriefAction.description: An ordinary endpoint to call. A dismissal also needs a reason, which the person chooses when they dismiss.

BriefCampaignItem.title: BriefCampaignItem
BriefCampaignItem.description:
Something the agents wait on or did (plan 07-06): `approval` is a pending (or since decided) approval, `activity`
an action executed, blocked or failed. `text` is written by code and `link` is a page of the app: nothing is decided
from the brief or its email.

BriefDecision.title: BriefDecision
BriefDecision.description:
One thing waiting for the person: a match, or the record changes someone suggested. A match nobody assessed
(is_assessed false) has no requirement table and no verdict: the search ranked it, no model has read it.

BriefDelivery.title: BriefDelivery
BriefDelivery.description:
in_app is the brief's own status. email is null when the person has not agreed to the email; otherwise what the
outbox row says: queued, sent, or failed (never sent: cancelled, expired or refused).

BriefIntroduction.title: BriefIntroduction
BriefIntroduction.description:
An employer asking whether the person would like to talk about a role. The person answers on Today; nothing about
what they would share is here.

BriefSettings.title: BriefSettings
BriefSettings.description: How often the morning brief comes (BRF-03). Whether it also comes by email is the brief_email consent.

CampaignProposalView.title: CampaignProposalView
CampaignProposalView.description: An offer to start a campaign for a job (plan 07-06). Nothing is started until the candidate clicks the card.

CitationView.title: CitationView
CitationView.description: A ledger row a reply rests on: the alias its text carries as [[d1]], and the real id of that kind.

CodeRequested.title: CodeRequested
CodeRequested.description: The same for every address, so the endpoint does not reveal whether an account exists.

ConsentChange.title: ConsentChange
ConsentChange.description: One consent a person grants or withdraws in PATCH /v1/me. A grant carries the wording version they were shown.

ConsentState.title: ConsentState
ConsentState.description: One consent as GET /v1/me reports it. A purpose that was never granted, or was withdrawn, has granted false.

ConstraintChange.title: ConstraintChange
ConstraintChange.description: PATCH: what is not named stays. A constraint's kind never changes; naming another one is refused.

ConstraintRef.title: ConstraintRef
ConstraintRef.description:
The constraint that removed a job. id and statement are null when the person has since removed it, or replaced it
with another of the same kind after the decision was made.

DocumentFacts.title: DocumentFacts
DocumentFacts.description:
What the parse produced from this file: facts the code could confirm, items it could not (kept as unconfirmed
facts of kind other, with the reason), and how many of all of them the candidate has not looked at yet.

DocumentHiddenText.title: DocumentHiddenText
DocumentHiddenText.description:
What was removed from the file as hidden or off-page text (REC-06): why, and a few samples to show the candidate.
Recomputed from the stored file, because the table keeps only the count.

DocumentView.title: DocumentView
DocumentView.description:
parse_error_code says why a document failed (or, on a succeeded one, that part of it could not be read:
partial_extraction); message is the same in words. hidden_text_flags is null until the document is parsed.

EditView.title: EditView
EditView.description: One passed edit, as the person sees it. A discarded edit has no view.

FactProvenance.title: FactProvenance
FactProvenance.description: Where a resume fact came from: the document, the character span in its text and the text at that span.

JobBrief.title: JobBrief
JobBrief.description: The job as a ledger row shows it.

JobCitation.title: JobCitation
JobCitation.description: Where in the posting the requirement is. The quote is the stored text at the stored span, never generated.

LocalSessionRequest.title: LocalSessionRequest
LocalSessionRequest.description: POST /v1/auth/local. The body is required (and so must be JSON) only so that a cross-site form cannot send it.

MatchJob.title: MatchJob
MatchJob.description: The job as a match shows it: the same fields as GET /v1/jobs/{id}, without its text.

MePatch.title: MePatch
MePatch.description: PATCH /v1/me: consents, the time zone and the brief schedule, any of them, at least one.

ModelState.title: ModelState
ModelState.description: The model the installation would call, and whether it has a key. Never the key itself.

NewConstraint.title: NewConstraint
NewConstraint.description:
kind is a plain string, not the enum: a kind the matcher cannot enforce is 422 constraint_not_enforceable with a
suggestion (API.md 3.2), not a field error.

NewPreference.title: NewPreference
NewPreference.description:
value defaults to the statement for kind other and untyped_dealbreaker and is required for the others; weight is
required (-3 to 3, never 0) except for a dealbreaker, which is always -3 (REC-04).

OrganizationInvitation.title: OrganizationInvitation
OrganizationInvitation.description: An open invitation to join an organization, sent to the person's address (HIR-01).

OrganizationMembership.title: OrganizationMembership
OrganizationMembership.description: An employer organization the person is an active member of, with their role in it (HIR-01).

PayRange-Input.title: PayRange
PayRange-Input.description: Annual pay in whole currency units (API.md 1.4).

Preview.title: Preview
Preview.description:
Counts only (API.md 3.11, INDEX deviation 8). 1 to 4 are shown as "fewer than 5"; said_yes is exact because each
of them is already on the shortlist. No identifier of a person appears anywhere.

PrivacyRequest.title: PrivacyRequest
PrivacyRequest.description: An export or a deletion, with the API's shared status words (API.md 1.9).

ProposalView.title: ProposalView
ProposalView.description: A record change the agent proposed. It is only a proposal until the candidate confirms event_id in the app.

RecordCitation.title: RecordCitation
RecordCitation.description:
A fact of the Career Record a verdict rests on. A fact the person has corrected or retired since still shows what
it said when the verdict was made, with is_current false. source is null for a fact the person wrote herself.

RecordEvent.title: RecordEvent
RecordEvent.description: One row of the change log or the proposal queue. before and after are the row as it was and as it became.

RecordView.title: RecordView
RecordView.description: The confirmed record on one page. Facts waiting for review are counted here; GET /v1/me/facts lists them.

RequirementIn.title: RequirementIn
RequirementIn.description:
One line of the list the employer confirms. An item typed by hand sends no span; an extracted one may send its
span back, and keeps it only while its text is still the description at that span.

RolePatch.title: RolePatch
RolePatch.description: Only the fields sent change. title and description cannot be cleared; pay_range, country and city can (null).

app__hiring__role_routes__PayRange.title: PayRange
app__hiring__role_routes__PayRange.description: Annual pay in whole currency units (API.md 1.4).
